object.customQuery:
SELECT
    c.*,
    cc.*,
    cp.*,
    dr.*,
    ds.*,
    df.*,
    so.*,
    dv.*
 
FROM WYNN_RESORT_DWH_DEV.STG_DATA.STG_CUSTOMER c
 
LEFT JOIN WYNN_RESORT_DWH_DEV.STG_DATA.STG_CUSTOMER_CONTACT cc
    ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
 
LEFT JOIN WYNN_RESORT_DWH_DEV.STG_DATA.STG_CUSTOMER_PREFERENCE cp
    ON c.customer_id = cp.customer_id
 
LEFT JOIN WYNN_RESORT_DWH_DEV.STG_DATA.STG_DINING_RESERVATION dr
    ON c.customer_id = dr.customer_id
 
LEFT JOIN WYNN_RESORT_DWH_DEV.STG_DATA.STG_DINING_SPENDING ds
    ON dr.reservation_id = ds.reservation_id
 
LEFT JOIN WYNN_RESORT_DWH_DEV.STG_DATA.STG_DINING_SPECIAL_OCCASION so
    ON dr.reservation_id = so.reservation_id
    AND c.customer_id = so.customer_id
 
LEFT JOIN WYNN_RESORT_DWH_DEV.STG_DATA.STG_DINING_FEEDBACK df
    ON c.customer_id = df.customer_id
 
LEFT JOIN WYNN_RESORT_DWH_DEV.STG_DATA.STG_DINING_VENUE dv
    ON dr.dining_venue_name = dv.venue_name;
